principles: No refund is ever executed automatically by the agent.
prepare_refund only assembles a refund package; money movement is a separate, externally-gated step.
Any dispute scoring at or above the risk threshold is routed to a human reviewer.
Customers are never accused of fraud; elevated risk is communicated as 'additional verification required'.
Every decision must cite policy_version, rule_id and a decision_reason.

rules.description: Item-not-received claim on a confirmed delivery with elevated fraud risk must be routed to human review.

outcome.reason: Delivery is confirmed and multiple risk signals are present; a human must verify before any refund is prepared.

rules.description: Item-not-received claim on a confirmed delivery with low fraud risk may proceed to a prepared refund.

outcome.reason: Delivery confirmed but risk signals are low; goodwill refund may be prepared for execution.

rules.description: Two distinct settled charges matched to a single order is a confirmed duplicate and is refundable.

outcome.reason: Two settled charges of equal amount matched to the same order; the duplicate settlement is refundable.

rules.description: An authorization hold alongside a single settled charge for the same order is NOT a duplicate and is not refundable.

outcome.reason: One charge is a temporary authorization hold that will be released automatically; only one real charge exists, so no refund is owed.

rules.description: Default safety fallback: anything unmatched is routed to a human.

outcome.reason: No specific rule matched; routed to human review as a safe default.

legal_source: UAE Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 on Consumer Protection
